versos.hebraico: מַשְׂכִּ֗יל לְאָ֫סָ֥ף הַאֲזִ֣ינָה עַ֭מִּי תּוֹרָתִ֑י הַטּ֥וּ אָ֝זְנְכֶ֗ם לְאִמְרֵי־פִֽי׃

controles.web: Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.
controles.kjv: Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
controles.livre: Povo meu, escuta minha doutrina; inclinai vossos ouvidos às palavras de minha boca.

versos.hebraico: אֶפְתְּחָ֣ה בְמָשָׁ֣ל פִּ֑י אַבִּ֥יעָה חִ֝יד֗וֹת מִנִּי־קֶֽדֶם׃

controles.web: I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old,
controles.kjv: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:
controles.livre: Abrirei minha boca em parábolas; falarei mistérios dos tempos antigos,

versos.hebraico: אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁ֭מַעְנוּ וַנֵּדָעֵ֑ם וַ֝אֲבוֹתֵ֗ינוּ סִפְּרוּ־לָֽנוּ׃

controles.web: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
controles.kjv: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
controles.livre: Os quais ouvimos e conhecemos, e nossos pais nos contaram.

versos.hebraico: לֹ֤א נְכַחֵ֨ד׀ מִבְּנֵיהֶ֗ם לְד֥וֹר אַחֲר֗וֹן מְֽ֭סַפְּרִים תְּהִלּ֣וֹת יְהוָ֑ה וֶעֱזוּז֥וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָֽׂה׃

controles.web: We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of Yahweh, his strength, and his wondrous works that he has done.
controles.kjv: We will not hide them from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of the Lord, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.
controles.livre: Nós não os encobriremos a seus filhos, contaremos à próxima geração sobre os louvores do SENHOR, o seu poder, e suas maravilhas que ele fez.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֤קֶם עֵד֨וּת׀ בְּֽיַעֲקֹ֗ב וְתוֹרָה֮ שָׂ֤ם בְּיִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִ֭וָּה אֶת־אֲבוֹתֵ֑ינוּ לְ֝הוֹדִיעָ֗ם לִבְנֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a teaching in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;
controles.kjv: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:
controles.livre: Porque ele firmou um testemunho em Jacó, e pôs a Lei em Israel, a qual ele instruiu aos nossos pais, para que eles ensinassem a seus filhos;

versos.hebraico: לְמַ֤עַן יֵדְע֨וּ׀ דּ֣וֹר אַ֭חֲרוֹן בָּנִ֣ים יִוָּלֵ֑דוּ יָ֝קֻ֗מוּ וִֽיסַפְּר֥וּ לִבְנֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children,
controles.kjv: That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:
controles.livre: Para que a geração seguinte dela soubesse; e os filhos que nascessem contassem a seus filhos;

versos.hebraico: וְיָשִׂ֥ימוּ בֵֽאלֹהִ֗ים כִּ֫סְלָ֥ם וְלֹ֣א יִ֭שְׁכְּחוּ מַֽעַלְלֵי־אֵ֑ל וּמִצְוֺתָ֥יו יִנְצֹֽרוּ׃

controles.web: that they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments,
controles.kjv: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:
controles.livre: E assim pusessem sua esperança em Deus; e não se esquecessem dos feitos de Deus, mas sim, que guardassem os mandamentos dele;

versos.hebraico: וְלֹ֤א יִהְי֨וּ׀ כַּאֲבוֹתָ֗ם דּוֹר֮ סוֹרֵ֪ר וּמֹ֫רֶ֥ה דּ֭וֹר לֹא־הֵכִ֣ין לִבּ֑וֹ וְלֹא־נֶאֶמְנָ֖ה אֶת־אֵ֣ל רוּחֽוֹ׃

controles.web: and might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that didn’t make their hearts loyal, whose spirit was not steadfast with God.
controles.kjv: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God.
controles.livre: E não fossem como seus pais, que foram uma geração teimosa e rebelde; geração que não firmou seu coração, e cujo espírito não foi fiel a Deus.

versos.hebraico: בְּֽנֵי־אֶפְרַ֗יִם נוֹשְׁקֵ֥י רוֹמֵי־קָ֑שֶׁת הָ֝פְכ֗וּ בְּי֣וֹם קְרָֽב׃

controles.web: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.
controles.kjv: The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Efraim, mesmo tendo arcos e flechas, viraram-se para trás no dia da batalha;

versos.hebraico: לֹ֣א שָׁ֭מְרוּ בְּרִ֣ית אֱלֹהִ֑ים וּ֝בְתוֹרָת֗וֹ מֵאֲנ֥וּ לָלֶֽכֶת׃

controles.web: They didn’t keep God’s covenant, and refused to walk in his law.
controles.kjv: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;
controles.livre: Não guardaram o pacto de Deus, e recusaram a andar conforme sua Lei.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשְׁכְּח֥וּ עֲלִילוֹתָ֑יו וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶרְאָֽם׃

controles.web: They forgot his doings, his wondrous works that he had shown them.
controles.kjv: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.
controles.livre: E se esqueceram de seus feitos, e de suas maravilhas que ele tinha lhes feito ver.

versos.hebraico: נֶ֣גֶד אֲ֭בוֹתָם עָ֣שָׂה פֶ֑לֶא בְּאֶ֖רֶץ מִצְרַ֣יִם שְׂדֵה־צֹֽעַן׃

controles.web: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
controles.kjv: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
controles.livre: Ele fez maravilhas perante seus pais na terra do Egito, no campo de Zoã.

versos.hebraico: בָּ֣קַע יָ֭ם וַיַּֽעֲבִירֵ֑ם וַֽיַּצֶּב־מַ֥יִם כְּמוֹ־נֵֽד׃

controles.web: He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.
controles.kjv: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.
controles.livre: Ele dividiu o mar, e os fez passarem por ele; ele fez as águas ficarem paradas como se estivessem amontoadas.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּנְחֵ֣ם בֶּעָנָ֣ן יוֹמָ֑ם וְכָל־הַ֝לַּ֗יְלָה בְּא֣וֹר אֵֽשׁ׃

controles.web: In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.
controles.kjv: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.
controles.livre: E ele os guiou com uma nuvem durante o dia, e por toda a noite com uma luz de fogo.

versos.hebraico: יְבַקַּ֣ע צֻ֭רִים בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַ֝יַּ֗שְׁקְ כִּתְהֹמ֥וֹת רַבָּֽה׃

controles.web: He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.
controles.kjv: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink as out of the great depths.
controles.livre: Ele partiu as rochas no deserto, e lhes deu de beber como que de abismos profundos.

versos.hebraico: וַיּוֹצִ֣א נוֹזְלִ֣ים מִסָּ֑לַע וַיּ֖וֹרֶד כַּנְּהָר֣וֹת מָֽיִם׃

controles.web: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
controles.kjv: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
controles.livre: Porque ele tirou correntes da rocha, e fez as águas descerem como rios.

versos.hebraico: וַיּוֹסִ֣יפוּ ע֭וֹד לַחֲטֹא־ל֑וֹ לַֽמְר֥וֹת עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן בַּצִּיָּֽה׃

controles.web: Yet they still went on to sin against him, to rebel against the Most High in the desert.
controles.kjv: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.
controles.livre: E ainda prosseguiram em pecar contra ele, irritando ao Altíssimo no deserto.

versos.hebraico: וַיְנַסּוּ־אֵ֥ל בִּלְבָבָ֑ם לִֽשְׁאָל־אֹ֥כֶל לְנַפְשָֽׁם׃

controles.web: They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire.
controles.kjv: And they tempted God in their heart by asking meat for their lust.
controles.livre: E tentaram a Deus nos seus corações, pedindo comida para o desejo de suas almas.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְדַבְּר֗וּ בֵּֽאלֹ֫הִ֥ים אָ֭מְרוּ הֲי֣וּכַל אֵ֑ל לַעֲרֹ֥ךְ שֻׁ֝לְחָ֗ן בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃

controles.web: Yes, they spoke against God. They said, “Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?
controles.kjv: Yea, they spake against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?
controles.livre: E falaram contra Deus, e disseram: Poderia Deus preparar uma mesa de comida no deserto?

versos.hebraico: הֵ֤ן הִכָּה־צ֨וּר׀ וַיָּז֣וּבוּ מַיִם֮ וּנְחָלִ֪ים יִ֫שְׁטֹ֥פוּ הֲגַם־לֶ֭חֶם י֣וּכַל תֵּ֑ת אִם־יָכִ֖ין שְׁאֵ֣ר לְעַמּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed. Can he give bread also? Will he provide flesh for his people?”
controles.kjv: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people?
controles.livre: Eis que ele feriu a rocha, e águas correram dela e ribeiros fluíram em abundância; será que ele também poderia nos dar pão, ou preparar carne a seu povo?

versos.hebraico: לָכֵ֤ן׀ שָׁמַ֥ע יְהוָ֗ה וַֽיִּתְעַבָּ֥ר וְ֭אֵשׁ נִשְּׂקָ֣ה בְיַעֲקֹ֑ב וְגַם־אַ֝֗ף עָלָ֥ה בְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: Therefore Yahweh heard, and was angry. A fire was kindled against Jacob, anger also went up against Israel,
controles.kjv: Therefore the Lord heard this, and was wroth: so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel;
controles.livre: Por isso o SENHOR os ouviu, e se irritou; e fogo se acendeu contra Jacó, e furor também subiu contra Israel;

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א הֶ֭אֱמִינוּ בֵּאלֹהִ֑ים וְלֹ֥א בָ֝טְח֗וּ בִּֽישׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: because they didn’t believe in God, and didn’t trust in his salvation.
controles.kjv: Because they believed not in God, and trusted not in his salvation:
controles.livre: Porque eles não creram em Deus, nem confiaram na salvação que dele vem;

versos.hebraico: וַיְצַ֣ו שְׁחָקִ֣ים מִמָּ֑עַל וְדַלְתֵ֖י שָׁמַ֣יִם פָּתָֽח׃

controles.web: Yet he commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of heaven.
controles.kjv: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,
controles.livre: Mesmo assim, ele deu ordens às altas nuvens, e abriu as portas dos céus;

versos.hebraico: וַיַּמְטֵ֬ר עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם מָ֣ן לֶאֱכֹ֑ל וּדְגַן־שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם נָ֣תַן לָֽמוֹ׃

controles.web: He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them food from the sky.
controles.kjv: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.
controles.livre: E choveu sobre eles o maná, para comerem; e lhes deu trigo dos céus.

versos.hebraico: לֶ֣חֶם אַ֭בִּירִים אָ֣כַל אִ֑ישׁ צֵידָ֬ה שָׁלַ֖ח לָהֶ֣ם לָשֹֽׂבַע׃

controles.web: Man ate the bread of angels. He sent them food to the full.
controles.kjv: Man did eat angels’ food: he sent them meat to the full.
controles.livre: Cada homem daquele povo comeu o pão dos anjos; ele lhes mandou comida para se fartarem.

versos.hebraico: יַסַּ֣ע קָ֭דִים בַּשָּׁמָ֑יִם וַיְנַהֵ֖ג בְּעֻזּ֣וֹ תֵימָֽן׃

controles.web: He caused the east wind to blow in the sky. By his power he guided the south wind.
controles.kjv: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind.
controles.livre: Ele fez soprar o vento do oriente nos céus, e trouxe o vento do sul com seu poder.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּמְטֵ֬ר עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם כֶּעָפָ֣ר שְׁאֵ֑ר וּֽכְח֥וֹל יַ֝מִּ֗ים ע֣וֹף כָּנָֽף׃

controles.web: He rained also flesh on them as the dust; winged birds as the sand of the seas.
controles.kjv: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea:
controles.livre: Ele fez chover sobre eles carne como a poeira da terra; e aves de asas como a areia do mar;

versos.hebraico: וַ֭יַּפֵּל בְּקֶ֣רֶב מַחֲנֵ֑הוּ סָ֝בִ֗יב לְמִשְׁכְּנֹתָֽיו׃

controles.web: He let them fall in the midst of their camp, around their habitations.
controles.kjv: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.
controles.livre: E as fez cair no meio de seu acampamento, ao redor de suas tendas.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּאכְל֣וּ וַיִּשְׂבְּע֣וּ מְאֹ֑ד וְ֝תַֽאֲוָתָ֗ם יָבִ֥א לָהֶֽם׃

controles.web: So they ate, and were well filled. He gave them their own desire.
controles.kjv: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;
controles.livre: Então comeram, e fartaram-se abundantemente; e satisfez o desejo deles.

versos.hebraico: לֹא־זָר֥וּ מִתַּאֲוָתָ֑ם ע֝֗וֹד אָכְלָ֥ם בְּפִיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: They didn’t turn from their cravings. Their food was yet in their mouths,
controles.kjv: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat was yet in their mouths,
controles.livre: Porem, estando eles ainda não satisfeitos, enquanto a comida ainda estava em suas bocas,

versos.hebraico: וְאַ֤ף אֱלֹהִ֨ים׀ עָ֘לָ֤ה בָהֶ֗ם וַֽ֭יַּהֲרֹג בְּמִשְׁמַנֵּיהֶ֑ם וּבַחוּרֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל הִכְרִֽיעַ׃

controles.web: when the anger of God went up against them, killed some of their fattest, and struck down the young men of Israel.
controles.kjv: The wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Israel.
controles.livre: a ira de Deus subiu contra eles; matou os mais robustos deles e abateu os jovens de Israel.

versos.hebraico: בְּכָל־זֹ֭את חָֽטְאוּ־ע֑וֹד וְלֹֽא־הֶ֝אֱמִ֗ינוּ בְּנִפְלְאוֹתָֽיו׃

controles.web: For all this they still sinned, and didn’t believe in his wondrous works.
controles.kjv: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.
controles.livre: Com tudo isto ainda pecaram, e não creram nas maravilhas que ele fez.

versos.hebraico: וַיְכַל־בַּהֶ֥בֶל יְמֵיהֶ֑ם וּ֝שְׁנוֹתָ֗ם בַּבֶּהָלָֽה׃

controles.web: Therefore he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.
controles.kjv: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.
controles.livre: Por isso gastaram seus dias em futilidades, e seus anos em terrores.

versos.hebraico: אִם־הֲרָגָ֥ם וּדְרָשׁ֑וּהוּ וְ֝שָׁ֗בוּ וְשִֽׁחֲרוּ־אֵֽל׃

controles.web: When he killed them, then they inquired after him. They returned and sought God earnestly.
controles.kjv: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after God.
controles.livre: Quando ele matava alguns dentre eles, então buscavam por ele, e se convertiam, e buscavam a Deus de madrugada.

versos.hebraico: וַֽ֭יִּזְכְּרוּ כִּֽי־אֱלֹהִ֣ים צוּרָ֑ם וְאֵ֥ל עֶ֝לְיוֹן גֹּאֲלָֽם׃

controles.web: They remembered that God was their rock, the Most High God, their redeemer.
controles.kjv: And they remembered that God was their rock, and the high God their redeemer.
controles.livre: E se lembravam de que Deus era sua rocha, e que o Deus Altíssimo era o seu libertador.

versos.hebraico: וַיְפַתּ֥וּהוּ בְּפִיהֶ֑ם וּ֝בִלְשׁוֹנָ֗ם יְכַזְּבוּ־לֽוֹ׃

controles.web: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.
controles.kjv: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.
controles.livre: Porém falavam bem dele da boca para fora, e mentiam com suas línguas.

versos.hebraico: וְ֭לִבָּם לֹא־נָכ֣וֹן עִמּ֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א נֶ֝אֶמְנ֗וּ בִּבְרִיתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.
controles.kjv: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.
controles.livre: Porque o coração deles não era comprometido para com ele, e não foram fiéis ao pacto dele.

versos.hebraico: וְה֤וּא רַח֨וּם׀ יְכַפֵּ֥ר עָוֺן֮ וְֽלֹא־יַ֫שְׁחִ֥ית וְ֭הִרְבָּה לְהָשִׁ֣יב אַפּ֑וֹ וְלֹֽא־יָ֝עִיר כָּל־חֲמָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: But he, being merciful, forgave iniquity, and didn’t destroy them. Yes, many times he turned his anger away, and didn’t stir up all his wrath.
controles.kjv: But he, being full of compassion, forgave their iniquity, and destroyed them not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his wrath.
controles.livre: Porém ele, sendo misericordioso, perdoava a maldade deles, e não os destruía; e muitas vezes desviou de mostrar sua ira, e não despertou todo o seu furor;

versos.hebraico: וַ֭יִּזְכֹּר כִּי־בָשָׂ֣ר הֵ֑מָּה ר֥וּחַ ה֝וֹלֵ֗ךְ וְלֹ֣א יָשֽׁוּב׃

controles.web: He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passes away, and doesn’t come again.
controles.kjv: For he remembered that they were but flesh; a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.
controles.livre: Porque se lembrou de que eles eram carne, e como o vento, que vai, e não volta mais.

versos.hebraico: כַּ֭מָּה יַמְר֣וּהוּ בַמִּדְבָּ֑ר יַ֝עֲצִיב֗וּהוּ בִּֽישִׁימֽוֹן׃

controles.web: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!
controles.kjv: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!
controles.livre: Quantas vezes o provocaram no deserto, e o maltrataram na terra desabitada!

versos.hebraico: וַיָּשׁ֣וּבוּ וַיְנַסּ֣וּ אֵ֑ל וּקְד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל הִתְווּ׃

controles.web: They turned again and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.
controles.kjv: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and limited the Holy One of Israel.
controles.livre: Pois voltavam a tentar a Deus, e perturbavam ao Santo de Israel.

versos.hebraico: לֹא־זָכְר֥וּ אֶת־יָד֑וֹ י֝֗וֹם אֲֽשֶׁר־פָּדָ֥ם מִנִּי־צָֽר׃

controles.web: They didn’t remember his hand, nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;
controles.kjv: They remembered not his hand, nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy.
controles.livre: Não se lembraram de sua mão, nem do dia em que os livrou do adversário.

versos.hebraico: אֲשֶׁר־שָׂ֣ם בְּ֭מִצְרַיִם אֹֽתוֹתָ֑יו וּ֝מוֹפְתָ֗יו בִּשְׂדֵה־צֹֽעַן׃

controles.web: how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan,
controles.kjv: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan:
controles.livre: Como quando ele fez seus sinais no Egito, e seus atos maravilhosos no campo de Zoã.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּהֲפֹ֣ךְ לְ֭דָם יְאֹרֵיהֶ֑ם וְ֝נֹזְלֵיהֶ֗ם בַּל־יִשְׁתָּיֽוּן׃

controles.web: he turned their rivers into blood, and their streams, so that they could not drink.
controles.kjv: And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that they could not drink.
controles.livre: E transformou seus rios e suas correntes em sangue, para que não bebessem.

versos.hebraico: יְשַׁלַּ֬ח בָּהֶ֣ם עָ֭רֹב וַיֹּאכְלֵ֑ם וּ֝צְפַרְדֵּ֗עַ וַתַּשְׁחִיתֵֽם׃

controles.web: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
controles.kjv: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
controles.livre: Enviou entre eles variedades de moscas, que os consumiu; e rãs, que os destruíram.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לֶחָסִ֣יל יְבוּלָ֑ם וִֽ֝יגִיעָ֗ם לָאַרְבֶּֽה׃

controles.web: He gave also their increase to the caterpillar, and their labor to the locust.
controles.kjv: He gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, and their labour unto the locust.
controles.livre: E deu suas colheitas ao pulgão, e o trabalho deles ao gafanhoto.

versos.hebraico: יַהֲרֹ֣ג בַּבָּרָ֣ד גַּפְנָ֑ם וְ֝שִׁקְמוֹתָ֗ם בַּֽחֲנָמַֽל׃

controles.web: He destroyed their vines with hail, their sycamore fig trees with frost.
controles.kjv: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost.
controles.livre: Com saraiva destruiu suas vinhas, e suas figueiras-bravas com granizo.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּסְגֵּ֣ר לַבָּרָ֣ד בְּעִירָ֑ם וּ֝מִקְנֵיהֶ֗ם לָרְשָׁפִֽים׃

controles.web: He gave over their livestock also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
controles.kjv: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
controles.livre: E entregou seu gado à saraiva; e seus animais a brasas ardentes.

versos.hebraico: יְשַׁלַּח־בָּ֨ם׀ חֲר֬וֹן אַפּ֗וֹ עֶבְרָ֣ה וָזַ֣עַם וְצָרָ֑ה מִ֝שְׁלַ֗חַת מַלְאֲכֵ֥י רָעִֽים׃

controles.web: He threw on them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of angels of evil.
controles.kjv: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels among them.
controles.livre: Mandou entre eles o ardor de sua ira: fúria, irritação e angústia, enviando mensageiros do mal.

versos.hebraico: יְפַלֵּ֥ס נָתִ֗יב לְאַ֫פּ֥וֹ לֹא־חָשַׂ֣ךְ מִמָּ֣וֶת נַפְשָׁ֑ם וְ֝חַיָּתָ֗ם לַדֶּ֥בֶר הִסְגִּֽיר׃

controles.web: He made a path for his anger. He didn’t spare their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence,
controles.kjv: He made a way to his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;
controles.livre: Ele preparou o caminho de sua ira; não poupou suas almas da morte, e entregou seus animais à peste.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֣ךְ כָּל־בְּכ֣וֹר בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם רֵאשִׁ֥ית א֝וֹנִ֗ים בְּאָהֳלֵי־חָֽם׃

controles.web: and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.
controles.kjv: And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; the chief of their strength in the tabernacles of Ham:
controles.livre: E feriu mortalmente a todo primogênito no Egito; as primícias nas forças nas tendas de Cam.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּסַּ֣ע כַּצֹּ֣אן עַמּ֑וֹ וַֽיְנַהֲגֵ֥ם כַּ֝עֵ֗דֶר בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃

controles.web: But he led out his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
controles.kjv: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
controles.livre: E levou a seu povo como a ovelhas; e os guiou pelo deserto como a um rebanho.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּנְחֵ֣ם לָ֭בֶטַח וְלֹ֣א פָחָ֑דוּ וְאֶת־א֝וֹיְבֵיהֶ֗ם כִּסָּ֥ה הַיָּֽם׃

controles.web: He led them safely, so that they weren’t afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
controles.kjv: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
controles.livre: Ele os conduziu em segurança, e não temeram. O mar encobriu seus inimigos.

versos.hebraico: וַ֭יְבִיאֵם אֶל־גְּב֣וּל קָדְשׁ֑וֹ הַר־זֶ֝֗ה קָנְתָ֥ה יְמִינֽוֹ׃

controles.web: He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.
controles.kjv: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, even to this mountain, which his right hand had purchased.
controles.livre: E os trouxe até os limites de sua terra santa, até este monte, que sua mão direita adquiriu.

versos.hebraico: וַיְגָ֤רֶשׁ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֨ם׀ גּוֹיִ֗ם וַֽ֭יַּפִּילֵם בְּחֶ֣בֶל נַחֲלָ֑ה וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֥ן בְּ֝אָהֳלֵיהֶ֗ם שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
controles.kjv: He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
controles.livre: E expulsou as nações de diante deles, e fez com que eles repartissem as linhas de sua herança, e fez as tribos de Israel habitarem em suas tendas.

versos.hebraico: וַיְנַסּ֣וּ וַ֭יַּמְרוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהִ֣ים עֶלְי֑וֹן וְ֝עֵדוֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א שָׁמָֽרוּ׃

controles.web: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and didn’t keep his testimonies;
controles.kjv: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, and kept not his testimonies:
controles.livre: Porém eles tentaram e provocaram ao Deus Altíssimo; e não guardaram os testemunhos dele.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסֹּ֣גוּ וַֽ֭יִּבְגְּדוּ כַּאֲבוֹתָ֑ם נֶ֝הְפְּכ֗וּ כְּקֶ֣שֶׁת רְמִיָּֽה׃

controles.web: but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were turned aside like a deceitful bow.
controles.kjv: But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.
controles.livre: E voltaram a ser tão infiéis como os seus pais; desviaram-se como um arco enganoso.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּכְעִיס֥וּהוּ בְּבָמוֹתָ֑ם וּ֝בִפְסִילֵיהֶ֗ם יַקְנִיאֽוּהוּ׃

controles.web: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their engraved images.
controles.kjv: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.
controles.livre: E provocaram a ira dele com seus altares pagãos,  e com suas imagens de escultura moveram-no de ciúmes.

versos.hebraico: שָׁמַ֣ע אֱ֭לֹהִים וַֽיִּתְעַבָּ֑ר וַיִּמְאַ֥ס מְ֝אֹ֗ד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel;
controles.kjv: When God heard this, he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:
controles.livre: Deus ouviu isto , e se indignou; e rejeitou gravemente a Israel.

controles.web: So that he abandoned the tent of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;
controles.kjv: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;
controles.livre: Por isso ele abandonou o tabernáculo em Siló, a tenda que ele havia estabelecido como habitação entre as pessoas.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לַשְּׁבִ֣י עֻזּ֑וֹ וְֽתִפְאַרְתּ֥וֹ בְיַד־צָֽר׃

controles.web: and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary’s hand.
controles.kjv: And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy’s hand.
controles.livre: E entregou o símbolo de seu poder em cativeiro, e sua glória na mão do adversário.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּסְגֵּ֣ר לַחֶ֣רֶב עַמּ֑וֹ וּ֝בְנַחֲלָת֗וֹ הִתְעַבָּֽר׃

controles.web: He also gave his people over to the sword, and was angry with his inheritance.
controles.kjv: He gave his people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.
controles.livre: E entregou seu povo à espada, e enfureceu-se contra sua herança.

versos.hebraico: בַּחוּרָ֥יו אָֽכְלָה־אֵ֑שׁ וּ֝בְתוּלֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א הוּלָּֽלוּ׃

controles.web: Fire devoured their young men. Their virgins had no wedding song.
controles.kjv: The fire consumed their young men; and their maidens were not given to marriage.
controles.livre: O fogo consumiu a seus rapazes, e suas virgens não tiveram músicas de casamento.

versos.hebraico: כֹּ֭הֲנָיו בַּחֶ֣רֶב נָפָ֑לוּ וְ֝אַלְמְנֹתָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִבְכֶּֽינָה׃

controles.web: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows couldn’t weep.
controles.kjv: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.
controles.livre: Seus sacerdotes caíram à espada, e suas viúvas não lamentaram.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקַ֖ץ כְּיָשֵׁ֥ן׀ אֲדֹנָ֑י כְּ֝גִבּ֗וֹר מִתְרוֹנֵ֥ן מִיָּֽיִן׃

controles.web: Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep, like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine.
controles.kjv: Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, and like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.
controles.livre: Então o Senhor despertou como que do sono, como um homem valente que se exalta com o vinho.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּךְ־צָרָ֥יו אָח֑וֹר חֶרְפַּ֥ת ע֝וֹלָ֗ם נָ֣תַן לָֽמוֹ׃

controles.web: He struck his adversaries backward. He put them to a perpetual reproach.
controles.kjv: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.
controles.livre: E feriu a seus adversários, para que recuassem, e lhes pôs como humilhação perpétua.

versos.hebraico: וַ֭יִּמְאַס בְּאֹ֣הֶל יוֹסֵ֑ף וּֽבְשֵׁ֥בֶט אֶ֝פְרַ֗יִם לֹ֣א בָחָֽר׃

controles.web: Moreover he rejected the tent of Joseph, and didn’t choose the tribe of Ephraim,
controles.kjv: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:
controles.livre: Porém ele rejeitou a tenda de José, e não escolheu a tribo de Efraim.

versos.hebraico: וַ֭יִּבְחַר אֶת־שֵׁ֣בֶט יְהוּדָ֑ה אֶֽת־הַ֥ר צִ֝יּ֗וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָהֵֽב׃

controles.web: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.
controles.kjv: But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.
controles.livre: Mas escolheu a tribo de Judá, o monte de Sião, a quem ele amava.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּ֣בֶן כְּמוֹ־רָ֭מִים מִקְדָּשׁ֑וֹ כְּ֝אֶ֗רֶץ יְסָדָ֥הּ לְעוֹלָֽם׃

controles.web: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.
controles.kjv: And he built his sanctuary like high palaces, like the earth which he hath established for ever.
controles.livre: E edificou seu santuário como alturas; como a terra, a qual ele fundou para sempre.

versos.hebraico: וַ֭יִּבְחַר בְּדָוִ֣ד עַבְדּ֑וֹ וַ֝יִּקָּחֵ֗הוּ מִֽמִּכְלְאֹ֥ת צֹֽאן׃

controles.web: He also chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;
controles.kjv: He chose David also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:
controles.livre: E ele escolheu a seu servo Davi; e o tomou dos apriscos de ovelhas.

versos.hebraico: מֵאַחַ֥ר עָל֗וֹת הֱ֫בִיא֥וֹ לִ֭רְעוֹת בְּיַעֲקֹ֣ב עַמּ֑וֹ וּ֝בְיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: from following the ewes that have their young, he brought him to be the shepherd of Jacob, his people, and Israel, his inheritance.
controles.kjv: From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.
controles.livre: Ele o tirou de cuidar das ovelhas geradoras de filhotes, para que ele apascentasse ao seu povo Jacó; e à sua herança Israel.

versos.hebraico: וַ֭יִּרְעֵם כְּתֹ֣ם לְבָב֑וֹ וּבִתְבוּנ֖וֹת כַּפָּ֣יו יַנְחֵֽם׃

controles.web: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.
controles.kjv: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.
controles.livre: E ele os apascentou com um coração sincero, e os guiou com as habilidades de suas mãos.
